profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Backend developer with experience coding in Scala, C++, Python, C#, and Javascript (Node.js, Next.js, Angular, Typescript). I solve complex problems and have a really good time doing it too.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description: Skills: Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked on the Mozenda web scraping product. Completed multiple
projects involving systemwide performance and data integrity
improvements. Regularly maintained code via bugfixes, package updates,
and refactors where necessary. Added multiple endpoints to the REST API.
Wrote unit and integration tests for all code. Key member of harvester
modernization team from .NET to Node.js/Typescript/Electron.

positions.title: Linux System Administrator
positions.description:
Worked on all linux servers in BYU’s on-prem cloud infrastructure.
Regularly used VSphere and its API to build new servers and manage
resource allocation across servers. Heavily used Ansible to automate all
workflows that could be automated. Ensured PCI compliance of all
payment servers by routinely analyzing logs and installing patches as
needed. Trained new team members on infrastructure and workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Modernized and improved speed of large (1,000,000+ lines) medical
claims processing program from C to the C++11 standard using various
scripts to update syntax, replacing defunct packages with better
packages, and doing extensive testing to ensure full functionality.
-Assumed stewardship over maintenance and feature development of the
android version of a medical insurance app with 500,000 users using Java
and Android Studio. Ensured successful deployment of biweekly builds.
